summary: First full E2E test run of HORAS BAJA POS. Comprehensive pytest suite of 29 API tests exercising auth/RBAC, HPP stripping for kasir, POS ready/indent sales, auto-PO generation with correct PREFIX+YY+4-digit format (CMC260001..), stock adjustments, add_delivery partial->close status transitions, payments/pelunasan, admin edit sale w/ add item, admin void restoring stock, offline_id idempotency, stock transfer, manual PO create/receive w/ stock apply, PO edit HPP override affecting debt, reports (P&L/stock/receivables), dashboard, expense CRUD, JSON+CSV backup (users blocked), and user creation. All 29 backend tests PASS. Frontend load/nav verified: admin dashboard shows all cards (omzet, profit, receivables, payables, credit approvals, due soon, deliveries, low stock alert Acrylic 2 Lembar). POS page renders with data-testids: tab-ready-stock, tab-indent-builder, pos-product-search, pos-cat-*, pos-product-0..14, pos-customer-*, pos-save-customer-checkbox, pos-delivery-date, pos-ongkir, pos-pay-tunai/transfer/piutang/dp, pos-submit-button. Kasir role correctly hides Produk/Supplier/Keuangan/Pengaturan/Laporan in sidebar and /reports redirects to /. Reports page renders Laba Rugi with chart, table & totals. Sales history shows dot badges (blue/green/yellow/orange) and footer summary totals correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: services.compute_status returns 'ready' for a fully-paid Tunai sale with 0 delivered_qty; this is by design (order status decoupled from payment) but ensure UI clearly separates 'Ready / Belum Dikirim' from 'Close (Selesai)' – verified via dot badge legend.

routes_purchases.receive_po sets both po['warehouse'] and po['stock_wh'] to new wh even when status is 'Draft'/'Dalam Proses' (no stock added yet). Correct because stock_applied stays 0 then, but if user later switches to 'Barang Diterima', adjust_stock delta computes to full qty — behavior verified via test_manual_po_create_receive.
sync_indent_pos preserves po_no even when items removed & voided; consider not voiding PO when at least 1 indent line remains (currently OK since it only voids when items list empties).
backup/export includes 'users' collection with password_hash — sensitive. Consider stripping password_hash or requiring re-hash on import. Admin-only endpoint so acceptable, but call it out.
dashboard endpoint iterates a nested `for s in await db.sales.find(...)` inside a comprehension for cash_in, which double-queries. Minor perf concern but functional.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed data created via API: TEST_Budi (ready sale), TEST_CV_Indent (indent sale + auto PO), TEST_SJ (delivery), TEST_Piutang (payment), TEST_Edit (edit sale), TEST_Void (void sale), TEST_Offline (offline idempotency), TEST_Exp (expense). These remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend E2E suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_horasbaja.py – regression run: pytest backend/tests/test_horasbaja.py -v. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Frontend login inputs use placeholder selectors (input[placeholder='Username'|'Password']) not data-testid. All other UI has data-testid. Kasir dashboard uses /api/dashboard without 'profit' key (admin-only). POS product cards are 0..14 sorted alphabetically by name (pos-product-0 = ACP Seven), so use pos-product-search to find seng. Test data 'TEST_' prefix – can be cleaned by main agent if desired.
